Clarabel-r

The main goal here is to ensure that this package has full support for warm starts for CVXR. So in order, the tasks are:

  1. Robustify this rust-based R package by examining any bad choices.
  2. Note that we use the latest savvy crate. This repo is local and you are free to read it fully.
  3. We also need BLAS so the r-src crate provides R’s BLAS.
  4. Provide facilities for warm starts especially in this CVXR project which uses clarabel.

Tasks

  1. Add simple examples to functions where not present.
  2. The vignette should add a section on updating. The Semi-definite program with a changed matrix would be a good example. It can go right after it and before Control Parameters.
  3. Update NEWS.md.

New Tasks

  1. I thought I’d used the values from ~/GitHub/Clarabel.rs/src/solver/implementations/default/settings.rs to populate our default settings. However, some seem to be off in R/clarabel.R for clarabel_control(). We need to align in a dev branch of this repo.
